category_summary: **Roadmap & Announcements:** Lead dev **Teknium** dominated the feed, and the headline is the tease that a **[Hermes mobile app](/?date=2026-10-19&category=social#item-8a8f4126ea38)** is coming soon — the batch's top engagement (~796 likes, 26.5k views) with visible community excitement. Right behind it, **[Day 0 support for Hermes Agent](/?date=2026-10-19&category=social#item-6ad48a32526c)** (398 likes, 34k views) signals fast ecosystem/partner adoption at launch, while a standalone post on 'the **[Android](/?date=2026-10-19&category=social#item-2184511022d4)** question' (294 likes, ~18k views) has followers openly speculating about platform plans. Smaller teases ('[Its nearly there!](/?date=2026-10-19&category=social#item-e94c09afcc48)', '[its coming too](/?date=2026-10-19&category=social#item-bef3fd0f2304)') kept the hype simmering without adding detail. **Security & Engineering:** The most substantive technical reveal was the project's **[three-day minimum package-age rule](/?date=2026-10-19&category=social#item-b1486ec92484)** designed to prevent supply-chain attacks — it explains a brief plugin-update delay and reads as a deliberate, safety-first practice likely to earn respect from security-conscious readers; a curious exchange with prominent security researcher **[@Jhaddix](/?date=2026-10-19&category=social#item-3701c4a219cc)** about kernel-level components adds further intrigue. **Tips & Support:** **Teknium** was in full support mode, giving readers concrete takeaways: the little-known **[`hermes debug share`](/?date=2026-10-19&category=social#item-69ecb9bcf40e)** command (with the **nous** flag for privately uploading logs to staff), confirmation of a same-day bug fix on the **[main](/?date=2026-10-19&category=social#item-cf25122692fa)** channel (with main-vs-stable guidance), the **[Docker](/?date=2026-10-19&category=social#item-fcaf6dd2d586)** terminal-backend config tip, an **[agentmail](/?date=2026-10-19&category=social#item-a53313dc4735)** recommendation for extending agent capabilities, and an open invitation for community **[plugin](/?date=2026-10-19&category=social#item-b8237315d4f8)** ideas (e.g., a desktop device-management plugin). **Community & Vibes:** **@NousResearch**'s merch ['fit pics'](/?date=2026-10-19&category=social#item-4a4ab589b860) call was the reach leader (55k+ views, 63 replies), and the official account warmly offered to [review a community project name via DM](/?date=2026-10-19&category=social#item-a8cafad2511b) ('respect the hustle'). Overall sentiment is bullish and playful — followers are energized by the mobile/Android expansion, appreciate hands-on lead-dev support and the visible security posture, and increasingly treat **Hermes Agent** as a daily-driver tool; low-substance one-line replies were excluded from the ranking.
